bundle.shortDescription: Pretrain, inspect and use LeJEPA models on your own data
bundle.longDescription: jepa-studio pretrains LeJEPA (JEPA + SIGReg) encoders on your own unlabeled data with a private PyTorch environment, shows what they learned, and plans with a learned world model.
